selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of hosiery and rule out misclassification as leggings or pants given the length.
To verify the boundary between the sock fabric and the skin/floor, ensuring no melting or bleeding edges.
To assess overall texture consistency of the knit pattern and identify any subtle noise or artifacts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the sock and the foot. AI often struggles with the ankle geometry, causing the sock to look like a tube stuck on a cylinder rather than conforming to the heel/arch. Also, verify if the stripes wrap continuously around the leg or if they break/disappear unnaturally on the sides.
